title: Python
subtitle: Readable automation glue connecting APIs, clouds and infrastructure.

tiles.label: CLI scripts
tiles.says: Python turns repetitive tasks into repeatable commands.
tiles.detail: argparse, logging and exit codes make scripts behave like proper tools.

tiles.label: Virtualenvs
tiles.says: Virtual environments pin dependencies per project.

tiles.label: Types & tests
tiles.says: Type hints and pytest keep automation trustworthy.
tiles.detail: Tested scripts can be changed with confidence.

tiles.label: HTTP APIs
tiles.says: requests and httpx call REST APIs with retries and timeouts.
tiles.detail: Integration with ticketing, monitoring and SaaS removes manual steps.

tiles.label: boto3
tiles.says: boto3 drives AWS with paginators and roles.
tiles.detail: Inventory, cleanup and compliance checks run across accounts.

tiles.label: Docker SDK
tiles.says: The Docker SDK controls images and containers from code.
tiles.detail: Build, test and clean up containers programmatically.

tiles.label: cron & timers
tiles.says: cron and systemd timers run scripts on schedule.
tiles.detail: Regular jobs handle reports, rotation and housekeeping.

tiles.label: CI checks
tiles.says: Pipelines run linters and validators on each change.
tiles.detail: Policy checks catch mistakes before deployment.

tiles.label: Reports
tiles.says: Scripts produce CSV, HTML or chat summaries.
tiles.detail: Visible results make toil measurable and reviewable.

declarations: Automate the repeatable; document the rest.
